notes.title: Update on May 31, 2025
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience!
This update introduces five new weapons:

1. Vaccine Bomb
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45272457/54b5aa982172705f28c6b348e6cc8e952c94e113.jpg[/img]
A holy bomb that scatters vaccine-filled projectiles and creates damage zones.

2. Shotgun
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45272457/5b3765d3cd814189d551fde7fd40c540d983ec62.jpg[/img]
Fires powerful bullets in a fan-shaped spread toward the front.

3. Bullet Rain
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45272457/e0b0e198d9e33de258c44513d8237702fbe1a7f0.jpg[/img]
Rains bullets across the entire screen like a storm.

4. Fire Bullet
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45272457/44231fd15479ac9fd4b3ef6c5e8f051f8b679975.jpg[/img]
Fires flame-based bullets that deal continuous burn damage.

5. Katana
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45272457/af2105af88865cbd42a1ad4ece8f27149b33406b.jpg[/img]
Swing a katana to deal close-range damage to nearby enemies.

We’re continuing development on Virus Hunter, so stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Upcoming Update Plans
notes.content:
We’d like to share our plans for future updates to Virus Hunter.

We are currently working hard toward completing the full version by the end of June.
	•	New weapons
	•	Additional stages and story content
	•	Other exciting features to enhance the gameplay (please look forward to it!)

Development is progressing smoothly with a focus on these areas.
There’s been a brief gap between updates, but we’re doing our best to bring you a more powerful Virus Hunter.
Thank you for your patience!

We truly appreciate your continued support.

notes.title: Update on February 22, 2025
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:

Added two new weapons
Added Stage 3
Added a new mid-boss
Adjusted sound effects (SE)

Additionally, several bugs have been fixed.

notes.content:

Additionally, several minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: 2025/01/04 Update Details
notes.content:
[Bug Fixes]

Fixed an issue where certain items could not be obtained correctly.
Improved UI placement issues.
Addressed minor bugs and glitches.

notes.title: Update Implemented
notes.content:
We have implemented an update today with the following changes:

[Bug Fixes]

Fixed an issue where some enemies would not freeze (updated to ensure they now freeze as intended).
[Other Changes]

Adjusted some enemies to drop recovery items at a low probability.
Tweaked the behavior of certain enemies.
Modified the visual effects of the damage field for some weapons.
Ongoing Work
We are currently addressing the following:

Adding new weapon types.
Adjusting the mechanics of certain enemies.
Introducing a character power-up feature.
The next update is scheduled for early January.

We apologize for the delay in completing some updates initially planned for this year. We sincerely regret any inconvenience caused to our players.

Thank you for your continued support of Virus Hunter!

notes.title: Update Notes - December 31, 2024
notes.content:
[Bug Fixes]

Fixed an issue where some enemies would not freeze (updated to ensure they now freeze as intended).
[Other Changes]

Adjusted some enemies to drop recovery items at a low probability.
Tweaked the behavior of certain enemies.
Modified the visual effects of the damage field for some weapons.

notes.title: Update Details for December 23
notes.content:
We implemented an update on December 23!

[Specification Changes]
・Removed the "Exit Game" option from the Game Over screen.
・Removed the HD resolution option from the settings.
・Added a close button to various screens, such as the options menu.
・Removed the UI displaying elapsed time within stages.
・Changed level-up behavior so that one of the currently equipped weapons is always displayed as an option.

[Bug Fixes]
・Fixed an issue where loading would not complete.
・Fixed button-related bugs.
・Fixed an issue where enemy HP display was incorrect in certain cases.
・Addressed several minor bugs.

Please note that with this update, if you were playing in HD resolution, it will be switched to Full HD upon the next startup.

We plan to continue updating the game in the future, so if you notice any bugs or issues, please report them on the forum! Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Update Details for December 16
notes.content:
We have released an update on December 16!

Here are the details of the update:
・Fixed a bug where stages would not transition properly
・Fixed issues with certain weapons (turret-type weapons that target enemies) and adjusted their performance
・Other minor adjustments

We plan to continue updating the game. If you find any bugs or issues, please let us know on the message board. Your feedback is greatly appreciated!
